2160: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered.
2163: A member of Hei's team, an emotionless spirit medium known as a "Doll." Her power lies in tracking and observation through direct contact with water.
2164: Huang's position can be interpreted as that of field supervisor. He is a human and only possesses strategic abilities. He has a general dislike for contractors and voices it regularly in spite of having to work alongside three of them.
2165: His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432.
2166: The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition.
2435: A high school student. Her father, Tahara, was a researcher who rarely came home, and her mother has passed away.
3213: Kurasawa Gai is Japan's number one detective. Formerly known as Matsukichi Gai, he was a police officer who quit the force to start his own detective agency.
3214: Kiko is Kurasawa Gai's secretary/assistant. Usually referred to as "flat-chested" by Gai, she's an upbeat, energetic girl who loves anime and cosplaying. In fact, she prioritizes her two hobbies over her job responsibilities.
3320: A Regressor who lost her powers and a significant portion of her memories after Heaven's Gate disappeared in South America, five years prior to the story's setting.
3552: The field leader, presently charged with investigating BK201 and his cohorts. November 11's ability enables him to freeze liquids, including blood in the human body he does not have direct contact with.
3571: The first confirmed Contractor, with her star's Messier code UB-001. She was originally a spy for MI6 with the codename February but later defected and joined the Syndicate, adopting "Amber" as her new name.
5432: A young boy with heterochromatic irises. He apparently is associated with Amber and seems to be working with her. Maki's ability allows him to perform some type of spontaneous combustion on objects that he touches with his hands.
5942: Contractor, Messier Code VI-952. He works as a bodyguard for the daughter of the leader of the Ch'ing-Long-Tang mafia. Zhijun has the power to make anything his blood touches explode. Simply by snapping his fingers the exact section his blood covers simply explodes.
10314: A woman who supports November 11. Her power creates hurricanes which result in downpours, coating everything in water so that November 11 can freeze it. Her remuneration is to drink beer.
10315: An operative of the syndicate even longer than Huang, Shihoko is a contractor tasked with the job of infiltrating Alma's organization to gather intel for an eventual assassination.
10316: Bertha is a large lady and a former opera singer. She is a contractor that is able to control the resonance of sound. By resonating a frequency that is the inverse of a target's resonance frequency, she can destroy a target.
10730: Kouno is a police offer. He doesn't usually eat fast food saying it can kill a person.
10787: Section 4's liaison officer with the Astronomy Bureau.
14774: Shinoda Chiaki was a former student who wrote a thesis on the physics within the gate and was appointed to the National Laboratory after her graduation. She had stolen classified information from the national lab, and was supposed to meet Luise, to give it to him.
15548: Kirihara's friend since high school. She works under the the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan
15762: A young child most often seen being led around by April. He is a Doll whose observation powers rely on glass as a medium.
15938: Hei's younger sister. Pai is the Contractor responsible for the disappearance of Heaven's Gate five years prior to the story's setting and had since vanished. Her name means white in Chinese, while Hei means black.
19289: A subordinate of Kirihara's. Traditionally wears a business suit. Despite being an officer, he seems to have little common sense as he infiltrated a gang operation undercover using his real name. He has admitted to finding Kirihara scary.
20168: A scientist who Hei meets as he infiltrates Pandora. Nick and Hei become friends and both have a fascination with the "real sky". Nick turns out to be a contractor and is revealed to have the ability to manipulate electricity, apparently the same as Hei's ability.
23452: Contractor with the ability to change bodies with other humans.
23853: The Black Reaper’s team is hunting for a missing black-market Doll - and the prize appears on his doorstep in the care of his new friend, Kenji.
23856: Elis was Yin's piano teacher when she was a kid, as well as a very famous Pianist.
26403: A Japanese born overseas, he is a high-ranking official within PANDORA.
26970: A contractor who started her own religion intended for those like herself. Pursued by the Syndicate for killing one of their operatives, her congregation is in danger of being brought down.
28897: A portly, ginger-haired man whose left eye is frequently shut. His contractor ability enables him to project concussive blasts from his palms. He appears to be Amber's right-hand man, carrying out operations necessary to the Evening Primrose.
37016: Chief of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, Public Security Bureau.
37774: Louis was the first contractor encountered in the series, at the beginning of Episode 1. A member of French intelligence, his power is gravity neutralization, which he can use to either clear large distances - or against opponents by sending them into space.
44775: A blonde-haired woman whose cover was as a secretary in the American embassy in Japan. Her ability is to teleport herself and anyone she is in contact with; however, any clothing is left behind.
55117: A member of Section 4. Kunio has grey hair and dark eyes. He typically wears a suit.
80679: A member of the Secret Intelligence Service (MI-6). November 11's superior.
82639: The Stargazer is a mysterious, old, priestess-like figure, that is used for tracking the actions of contractors. Her real name is Hoshimi, but she is often referred to as "the Stargazer". She lives at the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
127416: She is a member of the same organization that Hei's works for and is infiltrated at PANDORA's research facility.
355211: Aku Nobuhiro was part of the band Razz Ma Tazz. He wss the vocalist.
